status_history.owner_words: Owner placed the file in docs/marketing/approved-creative-examples/estate-sale/ as a good example of creative work.

source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.
source.event_date_visible: Saturday May 30 & Sunday May 31 · 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM · Katy, TX

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Top block on cream: seller name (gold) → KATY ESTATE SALE (very large dark serif caps) → category line → tagline. Middle: full-bleed photograph of the living room. 'KATY, TX' gold plate overlapping the photo's bottom edge. Bottom: two-column dates, dark band with tagline, URL line.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: One photograph of the actual room — two gold sofas, carved coffee table, rug, lamp, drapes — shown in situ. No extraction; the house is the merchandise context.
visual_read.composition_style: Three horizontal bands: type / photograph / dates. Poster-like, tall portrait. Thin gold border frame.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Wide serif caps for the title with letterspacing; two-column date pair with day names small and dates large; small caps for categories and tagline.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller name at top in gold; URL in a small line at the very bottom; a seller tagline band above it.
visual_read.cta_treatment: 'Visit LMAuctionCo.com for more details' — soft, factual.
visual_read.footer_treatment: Dark band with tagline 'Quality. Heritage. Timeless Style.' then the URL line.
visual_read.photographic_style: Interior / real-estate style photograph of the sale house, natural window light.

strongest_attributes: For an on-site sale the environment is shown, not extracted objects — the buyer is being invited into a house
A very large place-name title (KATY) — the location is the headline
Two-day date pair as two columns with large day numbers
Location plate ('KATY, TX') anchored on the photo edge
transferable_lessons: On-site estate sales call for an environmental-photograph family; extraction is for online auctions (missing from current families → proposed ENVIRONMENTAL_PHOTO)
Multi-day sales: a date-pair block with large day numbers and small hour lines
A category line and a place plate are enough supporting copy
do_not_generalize: Gold border, cream ground, seller taglines ('Luxury finds for the discerning collector', 'Quality. Heritage. Timeless Style.')
Six copy blocks — the tagline blocks would be dropped for Advantage.Bid

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Bands separate type from photograph; nothing sits on the merchandise except the small place plate.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Advantage.Bid version: seller/presenter, title, category line, date pair, footer = 5; taglines removed.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Real room; no composition of objects needed.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Photograph fills the middle ~55% of the canvas; title block ~25%; dates ~20%.

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
